condition: Unresectable or metastatic HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer
indication_tracked: After endocrine therapy and at least one line of chemotherapy in the advanced setting

eu.jca_note: Not in EU JCA scope: the EU application was filed before the EU HTA Regulation applied (12 January 2025).
eu.epar_summary:
Datroway is a cancer medicine used on its own in adults to treat breast cancer known as triple-negative breast cancer. In triple-negative breast cancer, the cancer cells do not have receptors (targets) for oestrogen and progesterone on their surface and do not make abnormally high levels of a protein called HER2 (HER2-negative). Datroway is used in patients who cannot receive medicines called PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors, when their cancer cannot be removed by surgery (unresectable) or has spread to other parts of the body (metastatic).

It is also used in patients whose cancer cells have targets for oestrogen and progesteroneon their surface (HR-positive) and are HER2-negative. It is used in patients who have had endocrine therapy (hormone treatment) as well as one additional cancer treatment, when their cancer is unresectable or metastatic.

Datroway contains the active substances datopotamab deruxtecan.

DE.opinion: Added benefit not proven in all three groups: HER2 IHC 0 after one chemotherapy line; HER2-low after one chemotherapy line (vs trastuzumab deruxtecan); after two or more chemotherapy lines.
DE.comparator: Capecitabine, eribulin or vinorelbine (HER2 IHC 0); trastuzumab deruxtecan (HER2-low); sacituzumab govitecan (later lines)
